'''Mimi Dai''' is a mathematician who specializes in [[partial differential equation]]s, [[fluid dynamics]], and [[complex fluids]]. She is a professor at the [[University of Illinois Chicago]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Mimi Dai receives 2022-2023 AMS Centennial Fellowship {{!}} Dept of Math, Stat, & Comp Sci {{!}} University of Illinois Chicago |url=https://mscs.uic.edu/news-stories/mimi-dai-receives-2022-2023-ams-centennial-fellowship/ |access-date=2023-04-10 |language=en-US}}</ref>

==Education and career==

Dai received her PhD in applied mathematics from the [[University of California, Santa Cruz]] in 2012. Her dissertation, ''Nematic liquid crystal systems and magneto-hydrodynamics system: The properties of their solutions,'' was supervised by her advisor, [[Maria E. Schonbek]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=195288}}</ref> She is currently a professor in the Department of Mathematics, Statistics, and Computer Science at the University of Illinois Chicago.<ref>{{Cite web |title=mdai {{!}} Dept of Math, Stat, & Comp Sci {{!}} University of Illinois Chicago |url=https://mscs.uic.edu/profiles/mdai/ |access-date=2023-04-10 |language=en-US}}</ref> She specializes in partial differential equations, fluid dynamics, complex fluids.

==Awards and honors==

Dai became an [[American Mathematical Society]] (AMS) Centennial Fellow in 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-02-23 |title=Mimi Dai Awarded 2022 AMS Centennial Fellowship - IAS News {{!}} Institute for Advanced Study |url=https://www.ias.edu/news/2022/mimi-dai-ams-centennial-fellow |access-date=2023-04-05 |website=www.ias.edu |language=en}}</ref> In 2021 Dai also became an [[Institute for Advanced Study]] (IAS) von Neuman Fellow in 2021.<ref>{{Cite web |title=von Neumann Fellow {{!}} Institute for Advanced Study |url=https://www.ias.edu/scholar-type/von-neumann-fellow |access-date=2023-04-05 |website=www.ias.edu |language=en}}</ref>  Dai has been an IAS Scholar since 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-01-27 |title=Mimi Dai - Scholars {{!}} Institute for Advanced Study |url=https://www.ias.edu/scholars/mimi-dai |access-date=2023-04-05 |website=www.ias.edu |language=en}}</ref> In 2018 Dai was awarded a [[National Science Foundation]] (NSF) grant for ''Mathematical Studies of Magnetohydrodynamic Flows with Hall Effect'',<ref>{{Cite web |title=NSF Award Search: Award # 1815069 - Mathematical Studies of Magnetohydrodynamics with Hall Effect |url=https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/showAward?AWD_ID=1815069&HistoricalAwards=false |access-date=2023-04-10 |website=www.nsf.gov |language=en}}</ref> and another grant from the NSF for ''Mathematical Analysis of Magnetohydrodynamic Flows with Hall Effect'' in 2020.<ref>{{Cite web |title=NSF Award Search: Award # 2009422 - Mathematical Analysis of Magnetohydrodynamic Flows with Hall Effect |url=https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/showAward?AWD_ID=2009422&HistoricalAwards=false |access-date=2023-04-10 |website=www.nsf.gov |language=en}}</ref>
